name: desktop-overlay
description: AG Pet - Desktop Pet Overlay Electron Application
author: lennielan

scripts.build: node ../scripts/sync-assets.js && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('renderer/index.html', 'dist/desktop-overlay/renderer/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('renderer/style.css', 'dist/desktop-overlay/renderer/style.css'); if (fs.existsSync('renderer/assets')) fs.cpSync('renderer/assets', 'dist/desktop-overlay/renderer/assets', {recursive: true});" && node ../scripts/sync-assets.js
